title: Developer Welcome Tour — Illustrated Compass for API + SDK Onboarding
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a compact, scannable set of onboarding illustrations and annotated product screenshots for the API/SDK quickstart doc pages. Deliver a visual 'compass' that guides developers through 4 core flows: credential creation and rotation, streaming setup and heartbeat/latency expectations, tool-calling (function/schema wiring) overview, and a minimal local SDK init flow. Assets must be lightweight SVGs + animated GIFs for hover states, plus one annotated PNG for release notes and a set of masked product screenshots for docs. Prioritize clarity for first-time integrators while keeping the style consistent with Redwood brand illustration language.
acceptance_criteria: Four primary illustrations (auth lifecycle, streaming flow, tool call wiring, local SDK init) exported as optimized SVG + 2x PNG variants
Two short animated GIFs demonstrating streaming token handshake and a single tool call lifecycle for use in docs and release email
Annotated product screenshot pack (6 shots) with PII/IP masking and clear callouts for where devs find keys and streaming toggles
Figma file with componentized atoms (key icons, stream heartbeat, tool-call sequence) and production-ready tokens
Design review approval from PM and Engineering and one follow-up usability check with developer advocate
design_notes: Art direction: compact iconography, single-panel narrative frames rather than long comic strips to reduce cognitive load
Color: use brand accent + two neutrals; ensure 3:1 contrast for small text callouts
Accessibility: provide alt-text copy for each image and a text-only flow diagram for screen readers
Technical: export SVGs with ID names and avoid embedded raster effects so docs tooling can recolor programmatically
Trade-offs: GIFs limited to 2-3 loops and 3s length to balance file size and clarity; consider Lottie only if marketing requests animated vector in product
